decisions.reason: Requiring orientation review for every component does not change component availability, sourcing standards, or fallback rules.
The orientation-review coverage does not change the required contents of the power-board production package.
Component orientation review is independent of the requirement that every board use lead-free assembly.
Reviewing every component's orientation does not alter connector labels, QR codes, or other board markings.
The phrase 'while setting it up' supplies task context, but the added orientation check is independently represented and does not change the account-access, upload, or Basic-part review requirements.
The orientation-review coverage does not change the required sensor-board BOM, Gerbers, drill files, or pick-and-place file.
The source adds review coverage but does not change any integrated-board production-package deliverable.
Checking all component orientations does not modify the main-board BOM or resolve its missing-component production issues.
The shared phrase 'every component' is incidental; PCB assembly orientation does not change enclosure mounting or drop-retention behavior.
The orientation-review expansion does not alter ESP32 pin access, breakout technology, module pin count, or header requirements.
Verifying every component's orientation does not change the established through-hole connector assembly type or coverage.
PCB component-orientation review does not modify the enclosure's easy-to-assemble usability requirement.
